verdict.rationale: Supabase documents an official CLI (`supabase init`/`supabase start`) that runs the full stack locally or in CI, can be pinned per project as an npm dev dependency, and is documented for agents in an LLM reference corpus (llms/cli.txt). It also ties into agent workflows: the CLI serves the MCP server locally at localhost:54321/mcp, and `supabase db advisors` exposes the same checks an agent pulls via MCP. Hands-on reports are mixed: some users found local setup easy, while Val Town couldn't get local development working. missing for 10: documentation of agent-friendly CLI ergonomics (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive auth for agents), consistent independent hands-on corroboration of CLI reliability.
